notes.zh: 评注：这三扇窗口发给不同的帝国——910 给毁掉贸易站的一方，920 给其他帝国，930 给一个符合条件的“系统所有者”邀请其接受重建（60天后）。
notes.en: Commentary: these windows go to different empires — 910 to the empire that destroyed the tradestation, 920 to the others, 930 (60 days later) to a suitable system owner offering to re-establish the station.

note.zh: 同一事件同时通知三类帝国，并非先后相继。
note.en: The same event notifies three kinds of empire at once, not one after another.

scope.zh: 贸易站被毁后的三类通知与重建流程已核对。
scope.en: The three notices after the tradestation is destroyed and the re-establishment flow were checked.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那个帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the other empire appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现敌对一方的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for the rival side appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this star system appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现行商一方的国家名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the caravaneers' empire appears here.
